questions.question: Describe your experience eliciting business requirements and translating them into user stories or detailed requirements for a technical delivery team.
In your Product Owner role at Leidos, how did you prioritize and manage the product backlog when stakeholders had competing needs?
Walk me through the data migration project at Leidos. How did you ensure that the logic in the 20 legacy reports was accurately replicated in SuccessFactors?
What approach did you use to document functional and non-functional requirements, process maps, and traceability on your previous projects?
Give an example of a time you worked with non-technical stakeholders to clarify an ambiguous reporting or data requirement. What was the outcome?
This role requires FACETS experience. What exposure have you had to FACETS, healthcare payer platforms, claims, membership, provider, or benefits-related systems?
How have you used Azure DevOps to manage requirements, user stories, defects, testing activities, or delivery progress in an Agile or hybrid SDLC environment?
Describe how you developed business rules for data quality and integrity in your current Data Analyst role. How did you validate that the resulting data was reliable?
Tell me about your experience developing test cases, defining QA or business acceptance testing entry and exit criteria, and coordinating defect resolution.
This role includes mentoring and knowledge-sharing responsibilities. How would you onboard a new business analyst and help them build domain knowledge within a technical team?
